meta.title: STAR HILL Residence — Luxury amid nature, on the slopes of Bogd Uul
meta.description: STAR HILL Residence: a luxury development designed by Aedas on the slopes of Bogd Mountain, 6.5 km from central Ulaanbaatar. Crystal, Diamond, Duplex and Penthouse residences of 2–5 rooms and 56.6–212 m², a 6,248 m² sports complex and 20,000 m² of landscaped grounds.

intro.label: Star Hill Residence
intro.heading: Luxury in the midst of nature.
intro.lede: Rising on the high ground of Ulaanbaatar, on the slopes of Bogd Khan Mountain, Star Hill Residence looks out over unspoilt nature to the south, west and east — and across the wide panorama of the capital to the north.
intro.body: A space, free from all the worries of the outside world, in which to rediscover your true self.
intro.aside: Khan-Uul District · Eastern foothills of Bogd Mountain

aedas.label: Architect
aedas.name: Aedas
aedas.body: Star Hill Residence is designed by Aedas, the international architecture practice. Its founder, Keith Griffiths, served as lead consultant on the project, advising on the architectural concept, the spatial design and the integrated masterplan.
aedas.founder: Founded by Keith Griffiths · lead consultant to Star Hill

photo.caption: Background: Hong Kong West Kowloon Station by Aedas

aedasProfile.title: About Aedas
aedasProfile.photoAlt: Aerial view of New Huanggang Port in Shenzhen, by Aedas

general.label: Overview
general.body: An international architecture practice founded in 2002, with 24 years of experience. Headquartered in Hong Kong, with offices across Asia, Europe, the Middle East and the Americas.

founder.label: Founder
founder.name: Keith Griffiths
founder.role: Founder and chairman of Aedas · architect and urban planner
founder.body: Keith Griffiths brings deep international experience in architecture and urban planning. He worked in Foster's team in London on the HSBC headquarters in Hong Kong, then broadened his practice through international projects across Asia, Europe, the Americas and the Middle East. Today, as founder and chairman, he leads Aedas's architecture and planning work worldwide.
founder.starHill: Drawing on that experience, he served as lead consultant to Star Hill, advising on the architectural concept, the spatial design and the integrated masterplan. He also helped shape the core design of the five-storey, glass-fronted sports and services complex — the project's modern face and functional plan.

items.name: Greater Bay Area Technology Finance Centre

featured.name: New Huanggang Port
featured.body: Renews the traditional link between city and port with a double-isolation design, a three-dimensional inspection route and a direct connection to the Shenzhen–Hong Kong railway.

featured.name: Qingshuihe Comprehensive Transportation Hub
featured.body: Masterplanned by a consortium of Aedas, China Railway Siyuan and Shenzhen Urban Transport: four metro lines, an intercity line, a high-speed line and surface transport joined in one of Shenzhen's key hubs.

featured.name: Rixos Financial Centre Road Dubai Residences
featured.body: An 87-storey luxury residential tower looking out over the Burj Khalifa and downtown Dubai.

featured.name: Shaw Tower Redevelopment
featured.body: A 35-storey premium mixed-use tower bringing together offices, retail, restaurants, lifestyle space and a sky terrace.

awards.label: Awards
awards.summary: Around 40 awards in the last two years reflect the team's creative design, the character of its projects and its leading position in the field.

items.name: A&D Awards
items.result: 10 projects selected among the best buildings with world-class architectural solutions.

items.result: 11 works selected among the best in international architecture and design.

architecture.label: International standard
architecture.heading: World-class architecture by Aedas.
architecture.lede: To make the most of the views and the setting, the buildings are wrapped in generous floor-to-ceiling glass, drawing natural light and the landscape into every room.

sculptural.title: One integrated plan
sculptural.caption: Four buildings on a 9,000 m² footprint, planned as one.

glass.title: Glass façade
glass.caption: Durable, high-performance glazing by Reynaers of Belgium.

light.title: Floor-to-ceiling windows
light.caption: Daylight and views in every room.

nature.label: Landscape
nature.heading: On the slopes of Bogd Uul.
nature.body: Of the 35,000 m² site, only 8,000 m² is built on; 20,000 m² is given over to landscape, so architecture and nature sit in balance. More than 250 trees and shrubs — Siberian blue spruce, pine, elm, maple, bird cherry, lilac and almond — give the grounds a new character every season.

experience.label: Resident comforts
experience.heading: Everything you need, in one place.

highlights.trail: Walking trail straight up Bogd Mountain
highlights.sports: Sports complex with reflecting pool and usable roof

sports.title: Sports complex
sports.body: A five-storey, glass-fronted 6,248 m² sports and services complex within the grounds: yoga and Pilates studios, a fully equipped gym, a 25-metre five-lane pool, sauna and jacuzzi, a premium restaurant, shops and an open terrace with a reflecting pool.

fitness.title: Fitness centre
fitness.body: A fully equipped 737 m² fitness centre on the complex's ground floor — generous space and modern equipment for a healthy, active life every day.

grounds.title: Landscaped grounds
grounds.body: Playgrounds for each age group, running and cycle paths, shade pavilions, a reflecting pool, a basketball court and an open terrace overlooking the city — all in a car-free zone.

concierge.title: Concierge
concierge.body: Reception, security, post, deliveries, cleaning and repairs — a dedicated service that takes care of everyday needs.

values.developer: STAR HILL Residence — a luxury residential development on the high ground of Ulaanbaatar, on the slopes of Bogd Khan Mountain.
values.architect: Aedas (international). Founder Keith Griffiths is the project's lead consultant. A&D Awards 2025 Architecture Firm of the Year.
values.location: Khan-Uul District, 11th khoroo, eastern foothills of Bogd Mountain. 6.5 km from the city centre.
values.residences: 2–5 rooms, 56.6–212 m², behind floor-to-ceiling glass. Residences, sports complex and landscape planned together across 40,000 m².
values.collections: Crystal (56.6–101.2 m² · 2–3 rooms), Diamond (95.7–142.3 m² · 3–4 rooms), Duplex (109.7–148 m² · 3–4 rooms), Penthouse (177.5–212 m² · 4–5 rooms).
values.amenities: 6,248 m² sports and services complex (pool, gym, sauna, restaurant), kindergarten for 1,000 children, concierge, usable rooftops, 600+ parking spaces, EV charging and 20,000 m² of landscape.
values.brands: Reynaers (Belgium), Hörmann (Germany), Tempini (Italy), ter Hürne (Germany), Kohler (USA), Danfoss (Denmark), Hyundai (Korea), SOLID (Korea).
values.financing: 6% mortgages for residences up to 80 m²; 30–50% down with interest-free instalments until handover; or 30% down with long-term loans from Khan Bank, TDB, Golomt and XacBank at 1.45–1.5% a month.

residences.label: Residences
residences.heading: Four collections.
residences.intro: Residences of {rooms} rooms and {area}, with floor-to-ceiling windows and fittings from the world's most respected brands.

crystal.subtitle: Crystal collection
crystal.body: A well-ordered plan, generous windows that let daylight in, and modern interiors — comfort and value for everyday life.

diamond.subtitle: Diamond collection
diamond.body: Fittings from world-renowned brands and a complete interior design make daily life easier, use every space intelligently and keep the home calm and orderly.

duplex.subtitle: Duplex collection
duplex.body: Two levels with a generous plan, high ceilings, large windows, luxurious interiors, advanced technology and fine craftsmanship — a home that expresses how you live.

penthouse.subtitle: Penthouse collection
penthouse.body: Expansive rooms, floor-to-ceiling windows, panoramic views across the whole city, luxurious interiors and the latest technology — the expression of your way of life.
